from scipy.stats import spearmanr

ic_per_fold = pd.Series([
    spearmanr(r["preds"], r["y_test"])[0] for r in results
])
print("Mean IC:", ic_per_fold.mean())
print("IC std:", ic_per_fold.std())
print(ic_per_fold)  # inspect fold-by-fold, not just the mean
caption: A healthy-looking mean IC can still hide a signal that collapsed in most folds -- always inspect the fold-by-fold series before concluding anything.
